name: Solid oak hardwood flooring (3/4in)
description: Solid 3/4in red oak strip or plank flooring, nailed to a plywood or OSB subfloor. Not for bathrooms or on-grade slabs; it swells and cups when wet.
source: Carton weights: Bruce American Originals red oak 3/4 x 3-1/4in, 60 lb per 22 sq ft (Home Depot product page, 2.7 psf); Bruce strip 2-1/4in, 56 lb per 20 sq ft (nfm.com, 2.8 psf); 2.75 psf used (x 4.88243).

name: Luxury vinyl plank (LVP)
description: Rigid-core click-lock luxury vinyl plank, floating over a flat subfloor or slab. Waterproof surface, so it suits pool houses and bathrooms.
source: Carton weights: LifeProof Pinecrest Place Oak 27.56 lb per 20.1 sq ft (1.37 psf, Home Depot Q&A); LifeProof Heirloom Pine 33.51 lb per 20.06 sq ft (1.67 psf, Home Depot Canada); SMARTCORE Ultra Woodford Oak 26.86 lb per 15.76 sq ft (1.70 psf, Lowe's); 1.5 psf used (x 4.88243).

name: Concrete sealer
description: Clear acrylic or silane-siloxane sealer rolled or sprayed onto a concrete slab or patio, priced per sq ft of one coat. Reapply every few years.
source: Estimate: a thin film with no published weight. Coverage from the Foundation Armor AR350 data sheet (up to 175 sq ft/gal per coat on porous concrete) and Quikrete Acrylic Concrete Cure & Seal (200 sq ft/gal as a curing compound).

name: Polished concrete (grind and seal)
description: A slab ground, densified and polished in place by a contractor, priced as the contractor's installed cost per sq ft (not a material you buy). The slab itself is a separate concrete part.
source: Estimate: polishing removes a little concrete and adds a densifier and guard coat; weight is negligible, 0.05 kg/m2 used so the part has some mass.

name: Epoxy floor coating
description: Two-part epoxy floor coating kit rolled onto a cleaned, etched slab, as in a garage or pool equipment room; priced per sq ft of one coat. A kit covers about 200-250 sq ft of bare concrete.
source: Estimate: about 2 gal of water-based epoxy (Rust-Oleum EpoxyShield) over 250 sq ft, assuming about 1.3 kg/L and half of it solids, about 0.2 kg/m2. Coverage from Rust-Oleum support (200-250 sq ft per kit on bare concrete).
